test_title: PYST 47: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

The accident site had become a __bear garden__ by afternoon.

options.text: A place of noise and disturbance

solution:
The solution is **A place of noise and disturbance.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct meaning of the underlined idiom 'The accident site had become a bear garden__ by afternoon' is **A place of noise and disturbance.**
 
• The accident site had become **a** place of noise and disturbance by afternoon.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss about *idioms:*

 
 
• A group of words established by usage as having a meaning not deducible from those of the individual words
